tagline: You can now add AI Function tasks to your Databricks jobs to run ai parse document, ai extract, or ai classify on the files in a volume or the rows of a table, without writing SQL.
what_it_does: You can now add AI Function tasks to your Databricks jobs to run ai parse document, ai extract, or ai classify on the files in a volume or the rows of a table, without writing SQL. Each run processes only the inputs that are new or changed since the previous run and writes the results to a Unity Catalog table that later tasks can read. This feature is in Beta.
why_it_matters: File events aren't required, but the task finds new and changed files faster with them.

capabilities.desc: USE CATALOG and USE SCHEMA on the catalogs and schemas of the input and output.

capabilities.title: SELECT on the input table
capabilities.desc: SELECT on the input table, or READ VOLUME on the input volume.

capabilities.title: CREATE TABLE on the output
capabilities.desc: CREATE TABLE on the output schema, for the run that creates the output table.

capabilities.title: MODIFY on the output table
capabilities.desc: MODIFY on the output table, for later runs.
